title: Interactive Learning Applications
description: Designed and developed cross-platform React Native (Expo) applications to support curriculum delivery. Built interactive learning modules, lesson demonstrations, assessments, multimedia experiences, and educational prototypes to enhance student engagement and simplify complex concepts.
highlights: Developed multiple cross-platform educational applications using React Native and Expo.
Built interactive learning modules, quizzes, and multimedia experiences.
Collaborated with curriculum designers to translate educational content into engaging mobile applications.

title: SingleInterface Connect
description: Built the mobile application from scratch using React Native, delivering a scalable cross-platform solution for enterprise retail management. Designed the application architecture, developed reusable UI components, integrated REST APIs, implemented authentication, push notifications, and Redux-based state management while collaborating with product, backend, and QA teams to deliver a production-ready application for Android and iOS.
highlights: Built the application from scratch.
Designed the React Native project architecture.
Developed reusable and scalable UI components.
Integrated REST APIs and implemented authentication workflows.
Implemented push notifications and Redux state management.
Collaborated with product, backend, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
Delivered a production-ready application for Android and iOS.

title: School Management Application
description: Designed and developed a cross-platform school management application from scratch using React Native. Architected a scalable solution to streamline school operations by enabling seamless communication between parents, teachers, and administrators through messaging, notices, announcements, timetables, school events, and push notifications, delivering a responsive and intuitive experience across Android and iOS.
highlights: Built the application from scratch.
Designed the project architecture and folder structure.
Developed reusable and scalable UI components.
Integrated REST APIs and implemented secure authentication.
Implemented role-based access for parents, teachers, and administrators.
Developed real-time messaging and parent-teacher communication features.
Built notices and announcements modules for school-wide communication.
Implemented timetable management and school events modules.
Integrated push notifications for important updates and reminders.
Optimized application performance and user experience.
Delivered a production-ready application for Android and iOS.
